Hi Luke,

Great to hear — thanks for sending the draft. Short answers up front: PO routing goes to AP (invoices@redwood.ai) with remit to Redwood Inference, Inc., 1200 Bayview Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107. For marketplace activation we require:

- Completed vendor intake form (filled and signed)
- W-9 (for US entities) or relevant tax form for non-US entities
- Billing contact + billing email for invoice receipt
- If you plan to use a customer-managed KMS key for encryption at rest, we need KMS ARN + a short key policy doc

Ive attached our standard marketplace intake (redwood_marketplace_intake_v2.pdf) and an internal KMS instruction stub for partner teams. Please send the completed intake and W-9, and note whether you will provide a KMS key or prefer Redwood-managed encryption.

If youre targeting the week of 8/31, lets lock a 30-min go/no-go call on Monday 8/31 10:00am PT — Ill send a calendar invite after we confirm paperwork.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin

Hi Skylake procurement team,

Thanks for the completed intake and W-9 — all received. Quick answers:

- KMS: We need an IAM principal that Redwood will use (redwood-service-role@redwood-inference) to be granted kms:Decrypt and kms:DescribeKey on the key ARN. See the attached kms_key_instructions.txt for a policy snippet you can paste into your key policy. If you prefer Redwood-managed encryption, we can skip the key exchange but note that you wont have direct key control.

- Invoicing: Monthly invoices with NET30 are fine; please include the PO number on the invoice and send to invoices@redwood.ai. We can honor electronic PDF invoices.

Next steps Im tracking:
1) Skylake returns signed intake + W-9 (done)
2) If using customer KMS, confirm key ARN + grant (pending)
3) Procurement issues PO and shares DocuSign link (pending)
4) Redwood does final entitlement + test charge and schedules go-live call

Ill open a procurement ticket internally to hold the activation window 8/31–9/02 once we have a PO.

- Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
